editorial_intro: This week brings an exciting mix of new Indian content across various genres, including romantic dramas, action comedies, and gripping thrillers. Notable titles like 'Love Always' and 'Gajab Raat' are trending, making it a perfect time to refresh your watchlist.

picks.title: Love Always
picks.synopsis: In this Tamil adaptation of the popular Korean webtoon 'Here We Go', a young couple navigates the ups and downs of love while dealing with family expectations and societal pressures. Their journey is filled with heartfelt moments and challenges that test their bond.
picks.why_watch: If you're a fan of romantic dramas, this series beautifully captures the nuances of love and relationships, making it a must-watch for anyone who enjoys heartfelt storytelling.

picks.title: Gajab Raat
picks.synopsis: Set over a single night in Delhi, corrupt sub-inspector Ajay Nirvit (Manoj Bajpayee) is assigned the case of a young journalist found brutally injured after being thrown from a moving car at Connaught Place. As officers from the CBI and NIA circle the case, he uncovers a conspiracy linking a powerful politician and pharmaceutical companies to a manufactured vaccine shortage.
picks.why_watch: Ritesh Shah's directorial debut, written and produced by Neeraj Pandey — a tense one-night thriller that hit No. 1 on Netflix India's Top 10.

picks.title: Chaar Yaar
picks.synopsis: Four childhood friends reunite for a road trip that takes unexpected turns when they stumble upon a criminal conspiracy. Their camaraderie and quick wit help them navigate through the chaos, leading to hilarious and action-packed moments.
picks.why_watch: With a mix of action and comedy, this film promises a fun ride that highlights the importance of friendship amidst chaos.

picks.title: Tum Mere Ho
picks.synopsis: A poignant love story unfolds between two individuals from different backgrounds who must confront their families' disapproval and societal norms. Their journey is filled with emotional highs and lows as they fight for their love.
picks.why_watch: This film beautifully portrays the struggles of love against societal expectations, making it relatable and heartfelt.

picks.title: Pooja Meri Jaan
picks.synopsis: A quirky romantic comedy that follows the misadventures of a young woman named Pooja, who is on a quest to find true love while juggling her career and family expectations. Her journey is filled with humorous encounters and unexpected twists.
picks.why_watch: This film is a light-hearted take on modern romance, filled with humor and relatable situations that will keep you entertained.

picks.title: Ashakal Aayiram
picks.synopsis: This Malayalam drama explores the life of a middle-aged man who reflects on his past choices and the impact they have had on his family. As he seeks redemption, he must confront the ghosts of his past.
picks.why_watch: A deeply moving narrative that resonates with anyone who has ever questioned their life choices, making it a must-watch for drama enthusiasts.

picks.title: The Terminal List: Season 2
picks.synopsis: In the second season, former Navy SEAL James Reece continues his quest for vengeance against those who wronged him. As he uncovers deeper conspiracies, he must confront his own demons while navigating a web of betrayal.
picks.why_watch: With intense action sequences and a gripping storyline, this series keeps you on the edge of your seat while exploring themes of loyalty and revenge.
